Quick Beef Chili
Ingredients:
- 1 lb ground beef
- 1 large onion, chopped
- 2 garlic cloves, minced
- 2 tbsp chili powder
- 1 tsp ground cumin
- 1 (15 oz) can kidney beans, drained and rinsed
- 1 (28 oz) can crushed tomatoes
- 1 cup beef broth
- salt and pepper to taste
Directions:
Brown the beef in a large pot over medium-high heat, breaking it up, about 6 minutes; drain the fat. Add the onion and garlic and cook until soft, 5 minutes. Stir in the chili powder and cumin and cook 1 minute. Add the beans, tomatoes and broth, bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
